title: Eagle Band, Frank Dusen, Celestin's Tuxedo band, Bill Jackson, Picou
summary: Asked about members of various bands; he recalls Dusen, Celestin's Tuxedo band and Alphonse Picou.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Ask him if they know any of the fellas in the Eagle.
You know any fellas in the Eagle Band?
Any of them?
Uh-huh. In the Eagle.
I don't remember them. No, huh? Ask him if he knew of Frankie Duso.
Do you know a fella by the name of Frankie Duso?
Yeah, how you in? He had a band. He's dead, isn't he? Yeah.
He had a good band, huh?
Yeah, he had a pretty good band. He had a good band. He didn't roll you all out? No. Who was with the saw stand and the tuxedo?
Who played in the tuxedo band with Papa Celestein when you used to play with them? I played with them.
And who else? Uh, I got bigger than fellas.
A fella by the name of Bill Jackson used to play with them?

Hmm? Bill Jackson used to play with them? Wasn't there a fella by the name of Bill Jackson played Papa Celestein when he played with him? I used to hear him talking about Bill Jackson. He played with him. He played with him.

He played with him. He played with him. He played with him. I don't know a fella by the name of Bill Jackson played Papa Celestein when he played with him. I used to hear him talking about Bill Jackson. He played Sam.
He said Sam was in the middle of the year. He played with Bill Nassar.
Well, I don't say a fella by the name of Bill Jackson.
I'm going to ask about Alphonse Picou if he played with him.
Picou.
Picou is, uh...
Picou. You played with him?
He played with us. Oh.
Uh-huh. I'm going to put him down.
When did he start? Was he, uh...
Did he play music the same time around when you started? No. Oh, he started after you, huh?
He was playing, but not the regular, you know?
